name: Vascon Engineers Ltd
title: Vascon Engineers Ltd - 533156 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Vascon Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose ~12% YoY to INR252 crores, with EPC revenue up ~70% QoQ to INR251 crores after cash-flow-stalled projects recovered.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue was about INR252 crores (+12% YoY), EBITDA about INR23 crores (+18% YoY) and PAT about INR13 crores (+14% YoY), per management. H1 FY27 revenue was INR404 crores versus INR447 crores, and H1 PAT fell to INR15 crores from INR34 crores, which included a one-time INR17 crore gain in H1 FY26. Recovery came from improved fund inflows on two government projects (Suphal and Sindhudurg) that had stalled in Q1. Real estate bookings rose to INR86 crores in Q2 from INR66 crores in Q1, driven by Tranquil Heights and Orchids.

financial_highlights.value: INR152 crores (Q1 INR66 crores, Q2 INR86 crores)

segments.name: EPC
segments.commentary: Total order book ~INR3,400 crores (external INR3,215 crores, internal INR185 crores), about 3.7x FY26 EPC revenue; government ~63% of the order book. Q2 revenue ~INR251 crores vs ~INR148 crores in Q1.

segments.name: Real estate
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 booking value INR152 crores and ~68,571 sq ft sold, with collections of ~INR43 crores. Q2 bookings of INR86 crores were mainly Tranquil Heights (INR58 crores, 36 units) and Orchids (INR25 crores).

guidance_outlook: FY27 EPC order inflow target INR1,500-2,000 crores; ~INR1,200 crores secured in H1, with another ~INR800 crores targeted before year-end per the CEO.
FY27 real estate indicative sales booking target INR250-350 crores; long-term ambition INR1,200-1,500 crores annual sales by FY31.
FY27 top line expected ~10% above FY26 (5-10% real estate and EPC matching or exceeding last year); no one-off items this year versus the FY26 Hyatt sale.
EPC H1 EBITDA margin ~10%, expected to improve marginally as Q3 and Q4 revenue is guided to be ~30% higher than H1 run-rate.
Medium term: EPC growth 15-20% YoY over next 3-4 years; real estate to grow ~5x over 5 years from less than INR200 crores of sales last year.
Collections guided at ~INR40-50 crores QoQ going forward, supported by Orchids construction-linked payments and Tranquil Heights 20-25% collection on booking.
capex_capacity: Qualcomm IT Park (Bangalore, INR660 crores incl. taxes) and SBI project: excavation started; full-fledged activity expected from around January (Q4 FY27).
Prakash CHS (Santacruz West, ~1-acre redevelopment): IOD, CC and RERA received; Bhoomi Pujan done; prelaunch in Nov-Dec 2026, full launch targeted January 2027.
Thane land: 25-acre acquisition stalled with no significant movement; management sees no revenue recognition from it for roughly a year.
Real estate strategy is asset-light: JV, JDA and redevelopment, with no land purchases using company equity or debt.
Suphal and Sindhudurg projects have scaled up again after cash flows resumed; monthly billing is peaking.
demand_pricing: Government share of order book ~60% per CEO; management comfortable at 50-65%, with recent wins skewed to private clients.

Orchids: ~10 units sold at ~INR31,000-32,000 per sq ft versus ~INR37,000 earlier, due to a one-time upfront-payment scheme (95% upfront with discount) run around Ganpati; collections of ~INR22-25 crores expected in Oct-Dec quarter.
Tulip Phase 3 (Coimbatore): last unsold lower-floor inventory sold at ~INR5,000 versus ~INR6,500 earlier, at a discount due to poor views and non-Vastu-compliant units.

Royal Rides project: stalled for over a year; management says no indication of start in next 5-6 months, so the order stays on the book for a few months before possible removal. Escalation clauses are in contracts.
New orders not materially better on margin or payment terms; focus is on higher-quality clients (Qualcomm, SBI).

Reliance Jamnagar order (INR131 crores) cancelled by mutual agreement after design change; no material impact, and no construction spend beyond 1-2 manpower. Company is exploring data centre EPC bids.

qa_highlights.question: Why did Orchids realisations fall from INR37,000 to INR32,000, and when will collections come in?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said an upfront-payment investor scheme around Ganpati, with 95% paid upfront at a discount, drove average sales to ~INR31,000-32,000; collections of ~INR22-25 crores are due by November, with ~INR8-9 crores already recognised in October. The scheme is not running now.

qa_highlights.question: When do the recently won Qualcomm and SBI projects start contributing revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Excavation has started, but full-fledged activity is expected from around January (Q4 FY27), after final approvals on design.

qa_highlights.question: What is the EPC bidding pipeline and government/private mix?
qa_highlights.answer: Company bids monthly across government and private work and is agnostic to building type; government exposure is ~60%. Management set a FY27 target of a couple of thousand crores and has ~INR1,200 crores secured, with another ~INR800 crores targeted; no L1 bids pending award that management is aware of.

qa_highlights.question: What is the timeline for the Prakash CHS launch and expected sales response?
qa_highlights.answer: Closed-circle soft launch in November-December, with full market launch targeted for January. Response is positive but too early to quantify.

qa_highlights.question: How should collections trend in real estate?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects ~INR40-50 crores of collections QoQ going forward, from Orchids construction-linked payments, Tranquil Heights (20-25% collected on booking) and Onyx prelaunch (10% of booking).

qa_highlights.question: Why were ESOPs granted and what is the revenue and margin guidance for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: ESOPs are a long-term retention tool for senior staff, floated roughly every 4-5 years. Guidance: top line ~10% above FY26; EPC EBITDA margin ~10% in H1, improving slightly in H2; no one-off gains this year versus the Hyatt sale in FY26.

risks_watch: Government client cash flow delays caused a semi-standstill on Suphal and Sindhudurg in Q1; collections must hold for the Q3-Q4 ramp.
Qualcomm and SBI full ramp-up is guided only from January 2027, so H2 execution depends on timing.
Royal Rides (~1-year stalled) may be removed from the order book if no action within about 6 months.
Thane 25-acre land acquisition unresolved; Maharashtra government cash constraints are cited.
Order inflow target of INR800 crores in H2 looks ambitious against the INR1,200 crores secured, and FY26 missed its order target by INR400-500 crores.
Orchids realisations fell to ~INR31,000-32,000 under the upfront scheme, which compresses per-sq-ft pricing; the Tulip Phase 3 discount reflected unit-level factors.
summary.management_tone: Confident on EPC recovery and order book, but cautious on timelines: several answers (Royal Rides, Thane land, Qualcomm/SBI ramp) were hedged or deferred. Management was candid about the Orchids discount and the stalled Royal Rides project.

growth.why: Management guides FY27 top line about 10% above FY26, with H2 EPC revenue guided ~30% above H1 run-rate; ~INR1,200 crores of the INR1,500-2,000 crore EPC order inflow target is already secured in H1 and EPC order book is ~INR3,400 crores (~3.7x FY26 EPC revenue), but no company-owned capacity is added and the Thane land is stalled.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: EPC H1 EBITDA margin ~10% (vs 9% prior year) and management expects a marginal improvement as Q3-Q4 revenue is guided ~30% above the H1 run-rate.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No company-owned capacity is added; Qualcomm IT Park (INR660 crores) and SBI project full activity from around January 2027 (Q4 FY27), with Prakash CHS full launch Jan 2027, but Thane 25-acre land is stalled with no revenue for about a year.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: FY27 top line guided ~10% above FY26, with EPC Q2 revenue ~INR251 crores (+70% QoQ) and H2 EPC revenue guided ~30% above H1 run-rate; EPC order book ~INR3,400 crores is ~3.7x FY26 EPC revenue.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Real estate is asset-light (JV/JDA/redevelopment, no land purchases with equity or debt) and no utilisation-driven capex is discussed; EPC is contractor model with no owned plant.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Guidance is ~10% top-line growth, with H1 revenue down to INR404 crores from INR447 crores and H2 order inflow of ~INR800 crores targeted against an ambitious backdrop after FY26 missed its order target by INR400-500 crores.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: H1 revenue fell ~10% YoY (INR404 crores vs INR447 crores) and H2 relies on ~30% step-up plus ~INR800 crores of new orders, with government cash-flow delays already stalling Suphal and Sindhudurg in Q1.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Prakash CHS (Santacruz West) prelaunch in Nov-Dec 2026 and full launch targeted January 2027; Onyx prelaunch also referenced, though sizing is not given.

rows.label: FY27 EPC order inflow target INR1,500-2,000 crores
rows.why: About INR1,200 crores secured in H1 with another ~INR800 crores targeted before year-end; FY26 missed its order target by INR400-500 crores, and Royal Rides (stalled over a year) may be removed from the book.

rows.label: Real estate collections of INR40-50 crores QoQ
rows.why: Orchids construction-linked payments (~INR22-25 crores due Oct-Dec quarter) and Tranquil Heights 20-25% collection on booking support the guided INR40-50 crore QoQ collections; H1 collections were ~INR43 crores.

rows.label: Data centre EPC bids
rows.why: Company is exploring data centre EPC bids after the INR131 crore Reliance Jamnagar order was cancelled by mutual agreement; no sizing given.

tone.note: Management was confident on the EPC recovery, order book (~INR3,400 crores) and ~10% FY27 top-line growth, but cautious on timing for Qualcomm/SBI ramp, Thane land and Royal Rides, and candid about the Orchids discount; analysts pressed on the H2 order target and collections.
